Strings.addon.title: Carrier Jumps
Strings.addon.description: Big countdown to your carrier's next jump with lockdown warning, alerts at 10 / 5 / 1 minutes and on departure, and a list of recent jumps.
Strings.ui.confirmed_you_were_aboard_otherwise_t: ✓ = confirmed (you were aboard). Otherwise the arrival is assumed from the departure time; lockdown and cooldown times are approximate.
Strings.js.carrier_lockdown_jumping_to_in_launch: ⚠ CARRIER LOCKDOWN · jumping to {0} in {1} · launch or stay docked
Strings.js.no_carrier_jumps_yet_book_one: No carrier jumps yet. Book one in carrier management and it'll count down here.
